ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Telangana
benefits_summary: Investment support of ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 per acre per year (split across Vanakalam/Kharif and Yasangi/Rabi seasons) for agricultural and horticultural farmers.
exclusions: Non-cultivable barren land or commercial real-estate layouts
documents_required: Dharani / Pattadar Passbook or ROFR Title Deed (for tribal farmers)
application_steps: Contact your cluster Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) in your village/mandal in Telangana.
Submit copies of your Pattadar Passbook and bank account details before the crop season.
Receive direct seasonal credit into your bank account.
